sn55.41:4.1: In this passage, SN consistently uses gaṇetuṁ (“to count”), while AN uses gahetuṁ (“to grasp”, AN 4.51:6.2).
sn55.41:8.2: Adopt the reading seyyā-nisajja-(a)ttharaṇassa from AN 4.51:8.2 and AN 5.45:8.2, against MS’s seyyāni paccattharaṇassa here. The correct reading is found here in BJT and PTS.
